description: NaBaGdWO₆ is Orthorhombic Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnnn space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.65 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.68 Å) and four longer (3.05 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Ba sites. In the first Ba site, Ba is bonded to twelve O atoms to form BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share faces with four equivalent GdO₆ octahedra and faces with four equivalent WO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.94-2.99 Å. In the second Ba site, Ba is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to twelve O atoms. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.69-3.28 Å. Gd is bonded to six O atoms to form GdO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent WO₆ octahedra and faces with two equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-18°. There are a spread of Gd-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.31 Å. W is bonded to six O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent GdO₆ octahedra and faces with two equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-18°. There are four shorter (1.96 Å) and two longer (1.97 Å) W-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ba, one Gd, and one W atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ba, one Gd, and one W atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ba, one Gd, and one W atom.
